\[
I_{\text{out}} = 255 + 8\, I(x, y) - \sum_{\text{8 neighbors}} I
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I(x, y)\): The input at the pixel

This is Pillow's CONTOUR filter: 8 in the center and -1 at the 8 neighbors, plus 255. The sum without the offset is a Laplacian, 0 in flat areas. So flat areas turn white. A pixel darker than its neighbors gives a negative sum and a dark line. A pixel brighter than its neighbors gives a value above 255, which clips to white. So each edge gets a dark line on its darker side.
